phase: Phase 13: Auto.js Pro And Desktop Node Parity Expansion

surfaces.summary: Phase 13 checklist and baseline verifier for Phase 12 completion, version.properties, open blockers, and Pro/Desktop profile planning.
surfaces.rollback: Remove the Phase 13 Gradle gate and keep Phase 12 summary as the latest planning source.

surfaces.summary: Machine-readable manifest and verifier for Phase 13 task ownership, status, profile, risk, evidence, and rollback tracking.
surfaces.rollback: Revert the Phase 13 manifest and verifier without changing runtime behavior.

surfaces.summary: Shared profile vocabulary, capability relaxation rubric, truth reporting, and user-facing profile diagnostics for staged Safe/Pro/Desktop/Debug promotion.
surfaces.rollback: Keep Safe Node Profile as the only accepted profile and reject Pro/Desktop profile metadata.

surfaces.summary: Close required internal blockers: crash evidence automation, second execution slot scheduling, packaged long-running service mode, full heavy resource stress, and Android-side package installation.
surfaces.rollback: Disable the promoted runtime path by profile flag and keep one-shot primary embedded execution as the fallback.

surfaces.summary: Auto.js Pro-style Node entry directives, $autojs global, Java interop, rhino.install(), importClass/importPackage, and JavaAdapter replacement decisions.
surfaces.rollback: Reject Pro Java/Rhino interop flags and keep require("rhino") in the default disabled JSON-only path.

surfaces.summary: Promote live UI, floaty/overlay, accessibility/selector, screenshot/image/OCR Pro compatibility surfaces.
surfaces.rollback: Fail closed to existing provider POC or stable denial errors for UI, overlay, accessibility, and media projection.

surfaces.summary: Expand Pro-style tasks, Intent/broadcast triggers, app/intent helpers, shell/root/Shizuku, notifications/settings, media/recorder/mediainfo, and utility-heavy Rhino modules.
surfaces.rollback: Keep P12 stable unsupported or blocked_by_design stubs and require explicit migration to supported Node bridge modules.

surfaces.summary: Create Node builtin parity matrix and stage desktop network and filesystem expansion: http/https, net/tls/dns, dgram, broader roots, and advanced fs APIs.
surfaces.rollback: Revert Desktop profile allowlist entries and keep raw network and broad filesystem access denied.

surfaces.summary: Stage desktop execution capabilities: worker_threads, process-worker replacement, vm, inspector, WASI, native addon loading, and child_process scoped runner.
surfaces.rollback: Disable desktop execution flags and keep high-risk builtins on stable denial paths.

surfaces.summary: Improve desktop module and process parity: full ESM loader, Android-side npm/package manager, broader stdlib conformance, and process/env/argv behavior.
surfaces.rollback: Return to current CommonJS/partial ESM resolver and deny Android-side install or unsafe process features.

surfaces.summary: Expand packaged APK capability metadata, plugin system, dependency compatibility corpus, and lock/integrity policy for Pro/Desktop distribution.
surfaces.rollback: Reject packaged Pro/Desktop profile metadata and keep JS-only local plugins plus host-side dependency validation.

surfaces.summary: Security corpus, rollback playbooks, privacy, foreground disclosure, and user prompts for relaxed capabilities.
surfaces.rollback: Disable relaxed capability groups and keep existing Safe Node Profile security corpus as the release gate.

surfaces.summary: Publish Pro/Desktop examples, type declarations, migration docs, Pro9 comparison updates, summary generator, and final Phase 13 gate.
surfaces.rollback: Keep Phase 13 examples and docs marked as gated until runtime promotion evidence lands.
